test_all_minigrid_environments: run the test suite that iterates over all registered MiniGrid environments and validates each one
test_grid_encode_decode_roundtrip: test that Grid.decode and grid.encode produce identical images for observation roundtrip validation
test_agent_sees_method: test the env.agent_sees method to verify the agent can detect objects at specific grid positions
test_minigrid_wrappers: test gym wrappers like ReseedWrapper, FullyObsWrapper, ImgObsWrapper, and ViewSizeWrapper on MiniGrid environments
test_seed_reproducibility: test that setting the same seed on a MiniGrid environment produces identical grid states
